tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Inv.name: Inventory checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Inv.description: Checks that the item catalog works, that received stock is recorded as batches, and that every stock change is logged and never rewritten.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Kes.name: Oversized request checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Kes.description: Checks that requests with too-large bodies are refused cleanly when the app runs on its real web server.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Kes.name: Real-server save checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Kes.description: Checks that save actions which reply with "no content" work on the real web server instead of crashing.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Lis.name: List-accounts command checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Lis.description: Checks the command-line tool that lists the farm accounts.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Lis.name: List ordering checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Lis.description: Checks that lists are ordered by business date first and then by when the row was created.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Log.name: Login rate-limit probe
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Log.description: Investigates why a login-attempt limit occasionally answered "wrong password" instead of "too many attempts" in test runs.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Log.name: Login input checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Log.description: Checks that overlong emails or passwords are rejected up front while empty ones still reach the normal login failure.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Log.name: Logout versus session-renewal race checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Log.description: Checks that logging out at the same moment a session is renewed cannot leave a usable renewed session behind.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Log.name: Log secret-hiding checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Log.description: Checks that passwords and other sensitive values are blanked out before anything is written to the logs.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Connected-app access checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Checks who can reach the connected-app (MCP) entry point and what they see, including sign-in discovery and token rules.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Connected-app identity pipeline checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Checks that a real signed-in connected app is identified correctly as its request passes through the app's normal steps.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Connected-app identity failure checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Checks the cases where working out who a connected-app caller is must fail.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Connected-app sales tool checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Checks the read-only sales and customer tools offered to connected apps, using a real sign-in.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Connected-app test helper
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Test helper that connects a pretend app to the connected-app entry point through the real sign-in flow.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Connected-app entry point checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Checks the connected-app entry point itself, such as who is allowed in and how it behaves on bad requests.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Connected-app paging checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Checks that long results for connected apps are cut into pages correctly and say whether more remain.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Connected-app partial permission checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Checks that an app granted only some of the permissions it asked for can use only those.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Connected-app read tool checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Checks the read-only farm data tools offered to connected apps, using a real sign-in.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Connected-app and screen consistency checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Checks that connected-app tools return the same results as the matching normal screens.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Connected-app data-scope checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Checks that a connected-app tool only touches data within the one request it is serving.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Connected-app tool error checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Checks that a failed tool call tells the app what was wrong and logs it sensibly.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Connected-app tool surface helper
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Test helper that lists what each connected-app tool is allowed to depend on.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Connected-app tool surface checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Checks that connected-app tools only depend on things they are allowed to use.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Connected-app write tool checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Checks the tools that let connected apps submit entries, record feed, water, purchases and expenses.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Daily-entry tool failure checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Checks that the connected-app daily-entry tool handles repeated and failing requests safely.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Daily-entry tool checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Checks that a connected app can record a day's egg entry through its tool using a real sign-in.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.name: Tool dependency scanner
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mcp.description: Test helper that walks a tool's dependencies to confirm none reach outside the current request.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/MeE.name: Own-profile checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/MeE.description: Checks the "me" actions where a signed-in person views and updates their own profile.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mig.name: Database-update command checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mig.description: Checks the command-line tool that brings the database up to date.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mig.name: Startup database-update switch checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mig.description: Checks that when automatic database updates at startup are turned off, the app does not touch the database structure.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mor.name: Bird-loss ledger checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mor.description: Checks that recording a bird loss is saved together with the caller's change, all or nothing.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mul.name: Two-server repeat-request checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mul.description: Checks that a repeated request is recognised even when two app servers share the work.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mul.name: Two-server rate-limit checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mul.description: Checks that sign-in attempt limits are counted together across two app servers.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mus.name: Forced password change checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Mus.description: Checks that a person told to set a new password cannot do anything else until they have.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Nam.name: Find-by-name checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Nam.description: Checks that lists of flocks and customers can be searched by name, ignoring upper or lower case.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Nam.name: Row name display checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Nam.description: Checks that returned rows carry the flock or customer name so pickers can show it without extra lookups.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.name: Connected-app creation date checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.description: Checks that a registered connected app records the business date it was created.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.name: Connected-app registration checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.description: Checks who may register a new connected app, with what details, and how often.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.name: Connected-app consent checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.description: Checks that approving a connected app requires the person's password each time.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.name: Connected-app partial consent checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.description: Checks that a person can approve only some of the permissions an app asks for, never more.
